title: Challenge 4: 3-Qubit GHZ State
storyScenario: A distributed quantum computing cluster requires a 3-party entangled state for non-local consensus.
targetGoal: 50% probability of |000⟩ and 50% probability of |111⟩ across 3 qubits.

starterCode.qiskit:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

def build_circuit():
    qc = QuantumCircuit(3)
    qc.h(0)
    qc.cx(0, 1)
    qc.cx(1, 2)
    return qc
starterCode.cirq:
import cirq
q = cirq.LineQubit.range(3)
circuit = cirq.Circuit(cirq.H(q[0]), cirq.CNOT(q[0], q[1]), cirq.CNOT(q[1], q[2]))

testCases.name: Hidden: Zero Leakage on Other 6 Basis States

editorial.algorithmicAnalysis: GHZ states demonstrate non-statistical quantum non-locality (Mermin-Peres magic square game).

hints: Start with H on Qubit 0, then CNOT from Q0 to Q1, then CNOT from Q1 to Q2.
